// why: Node 24 runs TypeScript by STRIPPING types — it never type-checks. This file is
for the editor and for an optional `npm run typecheck`, which needs a tsc you
install yourself; nothing here is required to run or test the server.
erasableSyntaxOnly and verbatimModuleSyntax keep the source inside the subset
type-stripping accepts: no enum, no namespace, no decorators, and type-only
